title: 建築拆除材料分選~Sorting of construction and demolition materials
focus: 拆除前盤點、選擇性拆解與多物料品質追蹤~Pre-demolition inventory, selective dismantling and multi-material traceability
summary: 以「拆除前盤點、選擇性拆解與多物料品質追蹤」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow pre-demolition inventory, selective dismantling and multi-material traceability through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 拆除前材料清冊~Pre-demolition material inventory
units.mechanism: 先盤點構件、材料、狀況與可再使用性，保留完整構件可能比破碎後回收更有價值。~Inventory components, materials, condition and reusability; retaining components may preserve more value than crushing.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：recoverable volume=area*thickness;200*0.15；計算 200*0.15 = 30 m3。適用限制：假想板體幾何量，未扣孔洞與鋼筋。~Original hypothetical teaching example: recoverable volume=area*thickness;200*0.15; calculation 200*0.15 = 30 m3. Applicability: Hypothetical slab geometry, without void/rebar deductions.
units.verify: 以圖面估算並用現場量測修正孔洞。~Estimate from drawings and correct openings with field measurements.
units.failure: 圖面與現況不符會使車次與暫存估算失真。~Drawing/site differences distort haul and storage estimates.
units.misconception: 建物面積可直接當成拆除廢料體積。~Building area directly equals demolition-waste volume.
units.practice: 在「拆除前材料清冊」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「圖面與現況不符會使車次與暫存估算失真。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pre-demolition material inventory, first reproduce 30 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Drawing/site differences distort haul and storage estimates." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 不確定材料的隔離分類~Segregating uncertain materials
units.mechanism: 受管制或不明材料需先由合格程序辨識，不可混入普通回收料；教材僅模擬分類與證據管理。~Regulated or uncertain materials need qualified identification before ordinary recycling; this lesson simulates classification and evidence management.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：verified coverage=verified locations/required locations;18/24；計算 18/24 = 0.75 fraction。適用限制：紀錄完整率，不代表剩餘材料安全。~Original hypothetical teaching example: verified coverage=verified locations/required locations;18/24; calculation 18/24 = 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Record completeness, not safety of remaining materials.
units.verify: 把未確認的六處保持待判定並列出所缺證據。~Keep six unverified locations pending and list missing evidence.
units.failure: 用外觀或年齡推論材質會產生錯誤放行。~Inferring material from appearance or age can cause false release.
units.misconception: 沒有看到危險標籤就能當一般建材處理。~No hazard label means material can be treated as ordinary construction waste.
units.practice: 在「不確定材料的隔離分類」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用外觀或年齡推論材質會產生錯誤放行。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for segregating uncertain materials, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Inferring material from appearance or age can cause false release." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 選擇性拆解順序~Selective dismantling sequence
units.mechanism: 先保全可再使用構件並分開容易污染的材料，有助降低後續混合；拆解順序需由現場結構計畫決定。~Preserving reusable components and separating contaminating materials reduces later mixing; actual dismantling sequence requires a site structural plan.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：reuse fraction=preserved components/identified components;45/60；計算 45/60 = 0.75 fraction。適用限制：假想非結構構件清冊，不提供實體拆除指令。~Original hypothetical teaching example: reuse fraction=preserved components/identified components;45/60; calculation 45/60 = 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical non-structural component inventory; no physical demolition instructions.
units.verify: 比較保護包裝前後的完整構件數。~Compare intact component counts with and without protective packaging.
units.failure: 將可用門窗混入破碎流會不可逆地失去完整件價值。~Sending usable doors/windows to crushing irreversibly loses component value.
units.misconception: 所有材料都先打碎再分類最能保留價值。~Crushing everything before sorting best preserves value.
units.practice: 在「選擇性拆解順序」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「將可用門窗混入破碎流會不可逆地失去完整件價值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for selective dismantling sequence, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sending usable doors/windows to crushing irreversibly loses component value." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 現場料箱與混入率~On-site bins and contamination rate
units.mechanism: 清楚標示、物流動線與抽查影響分流品質；混入率以非目標材占產品流質量計算。~Labels, logistics and audits affect segregation quality; contamination is non-target mass divided by product-stream mass.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：contamination=0.4/20；計算 0.4/20 = 0.02 fraction。適用限制：假想乾材料質量；同一料箱樣本。~Original hypothetical teaching example: contamination=0.4/20; calculation 0.4/20 = 0.02 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical dry masses from one bin.
units.verify: 比較靠近拆解點與遠端料箱的混入率。~Compare bins close to dismantling points with distant bins.
units.failure: 只增加料箱數而不改善動線可能無法降低混入。~More bins without better logistics may not reduce contamination.
units.misconception: 分類標示存在就保證工地沒有混料。~Having labels guarantees no mixing on site.
units.practice: 在「現場料箱與混入率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.02 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只增加料箱數而不改善動線可能無法降低混入。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for on-site bins and contamination rate, first reproduce 0.02 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "More bins without better logistics may not reduce contamination." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 破碎與粒徑分級~Crushing and size classification
units.mechanism: 破碎解離複合塊，篩分依尺寸分流；石膏、木材等同粒徑材料仍需其他識別方法。~Crushing liberates composite pieces and screening divides sizes; equal-sized gypsum or wood still needs another identification method.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：oversize return=feed*oversize fraction;50*0.18；計算 50*0.18 = 9 tonne/h。適用限制：假想篩分物料流；未含再循環增加量。~Original hypothetical teaching example: oversize return=feed*oversize fraction;50*0.18; calculation 50*0.18 = 9 tonne/h. Applicability: Hypothetical screen flow, excluding recirculation increase.
units.verify: 分析每個粒級的材質組成而非只報篩上重量。~Analyze material composition in each size class, not only oversize mass.
units.failure: 把尺寸合格視為材質合格會漏掉同尺寸污染。~Treating correct size as correct material misses same-sized contamination.
units.misconception: 一個篩網就能依材質分開所有拆除物。~One screen separates all demolition materials by type.
units.practice: 在「破碎與粒徑分級」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 9 tonne/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把尺寸合格視為材質合格會漏掉同尺寸污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for crushing and size classification, first reproduce 9 tonne/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating correct size as correct material misses same-sized contamination." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 金屬、輕物與礦物分流~Metal, light and mineral streams
units.mechanism: 磁選、風選與人工或感測分選處理不同性質；各段需追蹤目標回收與伴隨夾帶。~Magnets, air classification and manual/sensor sorting act on different properties; track recovery and entrainment at each stage.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：metal purity=4.5/5；計算 4.5/5 = 0.9 fraction。適用限制：假想磁性產品乾質量。~Original hypothetical teaching example: metal purity=4.5/5; calculation 4.5/5 = 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical dry magnetic-product masses.
units.verify: 量測金屬出口夾帶砂漿與礦物出口殘金屬。~Measure mortar entrainment in metal and metal remaining in minerals.
units.failure: 以磁選總重當純金屬會高估回收品質。~Calling all magnetic mass pure metal overstates quality.
units.misconception: 磁選回收率高就保證金屬純度高。~High magnetic recovery guarantees high metal purity.
units.practice: 在「金屬、輕物與礦物分流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以磁選總重當純金屬會高估回收品質。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for metal, light and mineral streams, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Calling all magnetic mass pure metal overstates quality." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 石膏與細料交叉污染~Gypsum and fines cross-contamination
units.mechanism: 石膏與其他細料可污染再生礦物料，需從源頭分流並用適用試驗確認下游用途。~Gypsum and other fines can contaminate recycled minerals; separate at source and verify suitability with applicable tests.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：gypsum fraction=0.3/30；計算 0.3/30 = 0.01 fraction。適用限制：假想質量濃度，非任何產品允收上限。~Original hypothetical teaching example: gypsum fraction=0.3/30; calculation 0.3/30 = 0.01 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical mass fraction, not a product acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比較源頭分流與混合後分選的殘留量。~Compare residuals from source separation and sorting after mixing.
units.failure: 先混後分可能讓細粉沾附所有顆粒而難以去除。~Mixing first can coat particles with fines that are difficult to remove.
units.misconception: 破碎後的細粉都可視為乾淨石粉。~All post-crushing fines can be treated as clean mineral powder.
units.practice: 在「石膏與細料交叉污染」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.01 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「先混後分可能讓細粉沾附所有顆粒而難以去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for gypsum and fines cross-contamination, first reproduce 0.01 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing first can coat particles with fines that are difficult to remove." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 運輸、堆置與實際密度~Transport, stockpiles and bulk density
units.mechanism: 鬆散料堆有空隙，車載體積與實體密度不可直接互換；重量及體積上限分別檢核。~Loose stockpiles contain voids, so haul volume is not solid-material volume; check mass and volume limits separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：haul mass=loose volume*bulk density;12*1.4；計算 12*1.4 = 16.8 tonne。適用限制：假想鬆散密度1.4tonne/m3，非車輛載重建議。~Original hypothetical teaching example: haul mass=loose volume*bulk density;12*1.4; calculation 12*1.4 = 16.8 tonne. Applicability: Hypothetical1.4tonne/m3 bulk density, not vehicle loading advice.
units.verify: 以地磅和車斗量測反算不同含水料的鬆散密度。~Infer bulk density from weighbridge and bin measurements at different moisture levels.
units.failure: 使用混凝土實體密度計鬆散料會錯估車次。~Using solid concrete density for loose debris misestimates haul trips.
units.misconception: 相同體積的所有拆除料都有相同重量。~All demolition materials of equal volume have equal mass.
units.practice: 在「運輸、堆置與實際密度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 16.8 tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用混凝土實體密度計鬆散料會錯估車次。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for transport, stockpiles and bulk density, first reproduce 16.8 tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using solid concrete density for loose debris misestimates haul trips." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 分流率與用途去向~Diversion rate and destination
units.mechanism: 分流率需明確定義再使用、回收、暫存與處置，運出工地不代表已完成有效回收。~Define reuse, recycling, storage and disposal explicitly; leaving the site does not prove useful recycling.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：verified diversion=(20+65)/100；計算 (20+65)/100 = 0.85 fraction。適用限制：20再使用、65已確認回收；不計未確認暫存。~Original hypothetical teaching example: verified diversion=(20+65)/100; calculation (20+65)/100 = 0.85 fraction. Applicability: 20reused and65verified recycled; unverified storage excluded.
units.verify: 把接收證明與實際用途逐批配對。~Match receiving records and actual use by batch.
units.failure: 把暫存當最終回收會重複計算或高估績效。~Counting storage as final recycling can double-count or overstate outcomes.
units.misconception: 廢料一旦被載走就等於100%回收。~Waste becomes100% recycled once hauled away.
units.practice: 在「分流率與用途去向」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.85 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把暫存當最終回收會重複計算或高估績效。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for diversion rate and destination, first reproduce 0.85 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Counting storage as final recycling can double-count or overstate outcomes." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 批次品質與數位追溯~Lot quality and digital traceability
units.mechanism: 材料清冊、分選結果、重量與檢驗需用一致批號串接，為下游使用者保留用途限制。~Link inventory, sorting, weights and tests with consistent lot identifiers and preserve use restrictions for downstream users.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：mass closure=outputs-input;20+65+10+5-100；計算 20+65+10+5-100 = 0 tonne residual。適用限制：同一批次、同一含水基準、所有出口皆納入。~Original hypothetical teaching example: mass closure=outputs-input;20+65+10+5-100; calculation 20+65+10+5-100 = 0 tonne residual. Applicability: Same lot/moisture basis with every outlet included.
units.verify: 加入一筆重複運單，觀察收支與追溯檢查如何抓錯。~Insert a duplicate haul ticket and observe mass-balance and traceability flags.
units.failure: 不同日期或含水基準混算會製造假的物料損失。~Mixing dates or moisture bases creates false material losses.
units.misconception: 重量收支閉合就能證明所有產品品質合格。~A closed mass balance proves all products meet quality requirements.
units.practice: 在「批次品質與數位追溯」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0 tonne residual，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不同日期或含水基準混算會製造假的物料損失。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for lot quality and digital traceability, first reproduce 0 tonne residual, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing dates or moisture bases creates false material losses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
